name: mpesa-mcp
description: MCP server for M-PESA (Safaricom Daraja) and Africa's Talking APIs. Enables AI agents to trigger STK Push payments, query transaction status, send SMS to 20+ African telecom networks, and top up airtime across East Africa. First African mobile money API in the MCP ecosystem.

tools.name: mpesa_stk_push
tools.description: Trigger M-PESA STK Push (Lipa Na M-PESA) payment prompt on a customer's phone. The customer receives a PIN prompt and confirms payment. Use for collecting payments from individuals.

tools.name: mpesa_stk_query
tools.description: Check the status of an STK Push request by CheckoutRequestID. Poll 10-30 seconds after initiating a push to confirm payment completion.

tools.name: mpesa_transaction_status
tools.description: Query any M-PESA transaction by its receipt number (TransactionID). Returns transaction amount, timestamp, phone, and status.

tools.name: sms_send
tools.description: Send SMS via Africa's Talking to one or many recipients across 15+ African markets. Supports up to 1000 recipients per call. Reliable delivery across Safaricom, Airtel, Telkom Kenya.

tools.name: airtime_send
tools.description: Send mobile airtime top-up to any number across Safaricom, Airtel, MTN, Vodafone, and 20+ African networks. Specify amount in local currency or USD.

relatedServers.name: wapimaji-mcp
relatedServers.description: Kenya water infrastructure MCP server — drought intelligence, borehole data

relatedServers.name: swahili-health-mcp

relatedServers.name: kenya-legal-rag

envVars.name: MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY
envVars.description: Safaricom Daraja consumer key from developer.safaricom.co.ke
envVars.example: Get free sandbox key at developer.safaricom.co.ke

envVars.name: MPESA_SHORTCODE
envVars.description: M-PESA Paybill or Till number. Sandbox default: 174379

envVars.name: MPESA_PASSKEY
envVars.description: Lipa Na M-PESA passkey from Daraja portal. Sandbox default provided in README.

envVars.name: MPESA_CALLBACK_URL
envVars.description: HTTPS URL for M-PESA transaction result callbacks. Must be publicly reachable.

envVars.name: MPESA_SANDBOX
envVars.description: Set to 'true' for sandbox (no real money moved). Set to 'false' for production.

envVars.name: AT_USERNAME
envVars.description: Africa's Talking username. Use 'sandbox' for testing.

envVars.name: AT_API_KEY
envVars.description: Africa's Talking API key. Get free at africastalking.com

envVars.name: MPESA_INITIATOR_NAME
envVars.description: M-PESA B2C initiator name. Only needed for B2C disbursement tools.

envVars.name: MPESA_SECURITY_CREDENTIAL
envVars.description: M-PESA B2C security credential (encrypted). Only for B2C tools.
